summary: Reviewed orchestrator/tests/test_prompt_renderer.py — two new tests scoped to WP-006.

test_clear_cache_forces_reread (TestLoadPartial): directly mirrors the pattern established by TestLoadTemplate.test_clear_cache_forces_reread. monkeypatch redirects _PARTIALS_DIR, writes v1, loads, writes v2, clears cache, asserts v2. Contract is verified correctly.

test_partial_include_in_pipeline (TestRenderPromptPipeline): well-structured end-to-end test. Exercises include resolution ({{> wp-scope-reminder}}), variable substitution in partial ({wp_id}), and conditional block evaluation in a single render pass. Asserts correctly that {{> is absent from the output.

Both tests follow existing patterns precisely (tmp_path scoping, monkeypatch.setattr, clear_template_cache in setup_method). No blocking issues. No fix-forward changes required. No documentation-forward items.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. Both new tests mirror established patterns exactly and impose no technical debt.

test_partial_include_in_pipeline is a particularly strong test: it validates include resolution, intra-partial variable substitution, and conditional rendering in a single render_prompt call, providing meaningful regression coverage for the full pipeline.
